```{r}

fatalstormdata <- read.csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv")

stormcount <- read.csv("../data/stormcount.csv")

stormdetails <- read.csv("../data/storm_details.csv")

```

```{r}

stormsimple2 <- stormdetails |>
  count(EVENT_TYPE, sort = TRUE)

g0 <- ggplot(data = stormsimple2, aes(x = fct_reorder(EVENT_TYPE, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(color = EVENT_TYPE, fill = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  coord_flip() +
  guides(color = "none", 
         fill = "none")

g0

```


```{r}
stormsimple <- fatalstormdata |>
  mutate(EVENT_TYPE = fct_collapse(EVENT_TYPE,
                                  Floods = c("Flood", "Flash Flood"),
                                  Winds = c("Thunderstorm Wind", "Marine Thunderstorm Wind", "Marine Strong Wind", "Marine High Wind"),
                                  Lightning = c("Lightning", "Marine Lightning"),
                                  Other = c("Waterspout", "Dust Devil", "Debris Flow", "Funnel Cloud"))) |>
  count(EVENT_TYPE, sort = TRUE)
  


g <- ggplot(data = stormsimple, aes(x = fct_reorder(EVENT_TYPE, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(color = EVENT_TYPE, fill = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  coord_flip() +
  guides(color = "none", 
         fill = "none")

g
```

```{r}

fatalstormcount <- fatalstormdata |>
  select(YEAR, EVENT_TYPE) |>
  unite(storm, YEAR, EVENT_TYPE, sep = ",") |>
  count(storm) |>
  separate(storm, into = c("YEAR", "EVENT_TYPE"), sep = ",") |>
  mutate(YEAR = as.integer(fatalstormcount$YEAR))

allstormcount <- stormdetails |>
  select(YEAR, EVENT_TYPE) |>
  unite(storm, YEAR, EVENT_TYPE, sep = ",") |>
  count(storm) |>
  separate(storm, into = c("YEAR", "EVENT_TYPE"), sep = ",") |>
  mutate(YEAR = as.integer(allstormcount$YEAR))

g2 <- ggplot(fatalstormcount, aes(x = EVENT_TYPE, y = n, fill = EVENT_TYPE, color = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
  transition_time(YEAR) +
  labs(title = "Number of fatal storms by type from 1950-2026",
       subtitle = "Year: {frame_time}",
       x = " ",
       y = "Number of events") +
  ease_aes("linear")

animate(g2, fps = 10)

```



```{r}
#| fig.height = 10


stormbar <- fatalstormcount |>
  mutate(lesstypes = fct_collapse(EVENT_TYPE,
                                  Floods = c("Flood", "Flash Flood"),
                                  Winds = c("Thunderstorm Wind", "Marine Thunderstorm Wind", "Marine Strong Wind", "Marine High Wind"),
                                  Lightning = c("Lightning", "Marine Lightning"),
                                  Other = c("Waterspout", "Dust Devil", "Debris Flow", "Funnel Cloud")))
  

g3 <- ggplot(stormbar, aes(x = YEAR, y = n, fill = lesstypes)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, begin = 0.1, end = 0.9, option = "A") +
  labs(
    title = "Storms causing fatalities",
    x = "",
    y = "# of storms",
    fill = "Type of storm",
    caption = "Note the difference in scale between total storms and fatal storms."
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 12)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1990, y = 200,
           label = "In 2011, there were 79,091 storm/weather events.\n269 (or ~0.34%) of those caused fatalities.",
           size = 4.5) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2003, y = 210, xend = 2010.5, yend = 250)
  

yearlystormtotal <- allstormcount |>
  group_by(YEAR) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n))

yearlyfataltotal <- fatalstormcount |>
  group_by(YEAR) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n))

propfatal <- yearlystormtotal |>
  inner_join(yearlyfataltotal, by = join_by(YEAR == YEAR)) |>
  mutate(prop = n.y/n.x)

G <- ggplot(propfatal, aes(x = YEAR , y = prop)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of storms with fatalities",
    x = "Year",
    y = "%") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  theme_classic()

G2 <- ggplot(yearlystormtotal, aes(x = YEAR, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Total number of storms",
    x = "",
    y = "# of storms"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
  

G2 / g3 / G +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2, 4, 2)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Storms in the United States",
    subtitle = "1950-2026, NOAA\n",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), 
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15))
  ) 


```
